name: com.rechoraccoon.avi-creator-essentials
description: Editor tools for VRChat avatar creators: a seam-free 3D/2D texture painter with layers, masks, emission painting, wet paint brushes, 3D gradients and stars, Blender-style bone posing in the Scene view for making animations, an outline generator with texture optimizing, PC-shader baking for Quest, and a mute toggle.
